Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director, Environmental Sustainability Country Strategy & Integration

#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Shape the connection between global environmental sustainability strategy and meaningful country-level impact. As Director, Environmental Sustainability Country Strategy & Integration, you will play a pivotal role in translating enterprise ambitions into effective country strategies, in line with Novartis global priorities, external developments and stakeholder expectations. The role will independently develop, lead and implement key strategic initiatives for country commercial organizations; and engage on these initiatives with health system partners.

This role reports to the Global Head, Social Impact & Sustainability Strategy and works closely with the Chief Sustainability Officer, Public Affairs, regional and country leaders, and the global ESG Committee (the Novartis executive-level decision-making body for Social Impact & Sustainability).

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Cascade Novartis global Social Impact & Sustainability (SI&S) strategy – with a focus on environmental sustainability – across commercial business units and country organizations, translating enterprise priorities into clear, practical guidance and locally relevant implementation roadmaps.

• Develop scalable sustainability solutions, turning country-level proof-of-concept initiatives into approaches with broader global potential (e.g., circularity programs and patient-care-pathway decarbonization initiatives).

• Monitor emerging environmental market expectations and requirements - including those of regulators, payors, HEOR/HTA organizations, health system partners and customers (e.g., through tenders) – and translate developments into insights, risks and recommended actions.

• Partner with Market Access, HEOR, Policy and Commercial teams to integrate environmental considerations into value propositions, market access strategies and healthcare-system engagement.

• Build partnerships and new initiatives that advance care-pathway decarbonization, climate-resilient healthcare and environmental sustainability; build relationships with health system stakeholders.

• Support country policy and advocacy activities focused on environmental sustainability, climate and health.

• Coordinate regional and country disclosure needs, including tender and green-procurement responses; support global Finance, Operations and Disclosure teams on data requests.

• Lead and support priority Sustainable Markets Initiative (SMI) and Pharmaceutical Environmental Group (PEG) workstreams, including circularity efforts, the Pharma Lifecycle Assessment (LCA) Consortium and patient-care-pathway decarbonization initiatives, coordinating internal country teams and external partners to deliver tangible outcomes.

• Support country-level implementation of Scope 3 strategies and associated transition plans, partnering with relevant functions to translate global priorities into locally actionable initiatives such as business travel, local distribution and electric-vehicle adoption.

• Guide country and global commercial teams on decarbonization and environmental sustainability priorities. Build country capabilities through practical guidance, playbooks, training and communities of practice.

Essential Requirements

• Master’s degree in Strategy, Engineering, Sustainability or Life Sciences, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• Strong knowledge on key environmental sustainability topics, incl. Scope 3 emissions, life-cycle assessment and product environmental footprints, circularity.

• Proven success delivering strategic environmental sustainability initiatives and influencing corporate sustainability agendas.

• Pharmaceutical industry experience with strong understanding of market access, health economics, public procurement and tender processes.

• Extensive experience leading complex strategic projects and programs involving senior leaders (incl. executive management, executive-1) and cross-functional teams.

• Ability to translate complex sustainability topics into clear, decision-oriented insights, recommendations and executive-level communications.

• Demonstrated success navigating complex matrix organizations and influencing across functions without formal line authority.

• Ability to balance strategic intent with operational reality; experience in enterprise integration, transformation or program orchestration roles.

• Strong experience developing multi-stakeholder partnerships and collaborations with health systems, policymakers, industry associations, customers and external partners.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:150,500.00 CHF to 279,500.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters . Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Descrizione del lavoro
Titolo del lavoro: Direttore, Sostenibilità ambientale Strategia e integrazione del paese

#LI-Hybrid #

Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

Formare il legame tra la strategia globale di sostenibilità ambientale e un impatto significativo a livello di paese. In qualità di Direttore, Environmental Sustainability Country Strategy & Integration, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella traduzione delle ambizioni aziendali in strategie di paese efficaci, in linea con le priorità globali di Novartis, gli sviluppi esterni e le aspettative degli stakeholder. Il ruolo si svilupperà, guiderà e implementerà iniziative strategiche chiave per le organizzazioni commerciali dei paesi; e si impegnerà su queste iniziative con i partner del sistema sanitario.

Questo ruolo riporta alla Global Head, Social Impact & Sustainability Strategy e lavora a stretto contatto con il Chief Sustainability Officer, gli Affari Pubblici, i leader regionali e nazionali, e il Comitato ESG globale (l'organo decisionale a livello esecutivo Novartis per l'impatto sociale e la sostenibilità).

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• La strategia di Cascade Novartis Global Social Impact & Sustainability (SI&S) – con un focus sulla sostenibilità ambientale – attraverso le business unit commerciali e le organizzazioni di paesi, traducendo le priorità aziendali in una guida chiara, pratica e roadmap di implementazione localmente rilevanti.

• Sviluppare soluzioni di sostenibilità scalabili, trasformando le iniziative di bonifica di livello nazionale in approcci con un potenziale globale più ampio (ad esempio, programmi di circolarità e iniziative di decarbonizzazione paziente-care-pathway).

• Monitorare le aspettative e i requisiti del mercato ambientale emergenti - compresi quelli dei regolatori, dei payors, delle organizzazioni HEOR/HTA, dei partner del sistema sanitario e dei clienti (ad esempio, attraverso le offerte) - e tradurre gli sviluppi in insight, rischi e azioni raccomandate.

• Partner con i team Market Access, HEOR, Policy e Commercial per integrare le considerazioni ambientali in proposizioni di valore, strategie di accesso al mercato e impegno del sistema sanitario.

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director, Environmental Sustainability Country Strategy & Integration

#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Shape the connection between global environmental sustainability strategy and meaningful country-level impact. As Director, Environmental Sustainability Country Strategy & Integration, you will play a pivotal role in translating enterprise ambitions into effective country strategies, in line with Novartis global priorities, external developments and stakeholder expectations. The role will independently develop, lead and implement key strategic initiatives for country commercial organizations; and engage on these initiatives with health system partners.

This role reports to the Global Head, Social Impact & Sustainability Strategy and works closely with the Chief Sustainability Officer, Public Affairs, regional and country leaders, and the global ESG Committee (the Novartis executive-level decision-making body for Social Impact & Sustainability).

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Cascade Novartis global Social Impact & Sustainability (SI&S) strategy – with a focus on environmental sustainability – across commercial business units and country organizations, translating enterprise priorities into clear, practical guidance and locally relevant implementation roadmaps.

• Develop scalable sustainability solutions, turning country-level proof-of-concept initiatives into approaches with broader global potential (e.g., circularity programs and patient-care-pathway decarbonization initiatives).

• Monitor emerging environmental market expectations and requirements - including those of regulators, payors, HEOR/HTA organizations, health system partners and customers (e.g., through tenders) – and translate developments into insights, risks and recommended actions.

• Partner with Market Access, HEOR, Policy and Commercial teams to integrate environmental considerations into value propositions, market access strategies and healthcare-system engagement.

• Build partnerships and new initiatives that advance care-pathway decarbonization, climate-resilient healthcare and environmental sustainability; build relationships with health system stakeholders.

• Support country policy and advocacy activities focused on environmental sustainability, climate and health.

• Coordinate regional and country disclosure needs, including tender and green-procurement responses; support global Finance, Operations and Disclosure teams on data requests.

• Lead and support priority Sustainable Markets Initiative (SMI) and Pharmaceutical Environmental Group (PEG) workstreams, including circularity efforts, the Pharma Lifecycle Assessment (LCA) Consortium and patient-care-pathway decarbonization initiatives, coordinating internal country teams and external partners to deliver tangible outcomes.

• Support country-level implementation of Scope 3 strategies and associated transition plans, partnering with relevant functions to translate global priorities into locally actionable initiatives such as business travel, local distribution and electric-vehicle adoption.

• Guide country and global commercial teams on decarbonization and environmental sustainability priorities. Build country capabilities through practical guidance, playbooks, training and communities of practice.

Essential Requirements

• Master’s degree in Strategy, Engineering, Sustainability or Life Sciences, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• Strong knowledge on key environmental sustainability topics, incl. Scope 3 emissions, life-cycle assessment and product environmental footprints, circularity.

• Proven success delivering strategic environmental sustainability initiatives and influencing corporate sustainability agendas.

• Pharmaceutical industry experience with strong understanding of market access, health economics, public procurement and tender processes.

• Extensive experience leading complex strategic projects and programs involving senior leaders (incl. executive management, executive-1) and cross-functional teams.

• Ability to translate complex sustainability topics into clear, decision-oriented insights, recommendations and executive-level communications.

• Demonstrated success navigating complex matrix organizations and influencing across functions without formal line authority.

• Ability to balance strategic intent with operational reality; experience in enterprise integration, transformation or program orchestration roles.

• Strong experience developing multi-stakeholder partnerships and collaborations with health systems, policymakers, industry associations, customers and external partners.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters . Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

• Entwicklung skalierbarer Nachhaltigkeitslösungen, die Proof-of-Concept-Initiativen auf Länderebene in Ansätze mit einem breiteren globalen Potenzial umwandeln (z. B. Kreislaufprogramme und Dekarbonisierungsinitiativen für Patientenversorgung).

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen zur ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit und bei der Beeinflussung der Nachhaltigkeitsagenden von Unternehmen.

• Fähigkeit, strategische Absichten mit der operativen Realität in Einklang zu bringen; Erfahrung in Unternehmensintegration, Transformation oder Programmorchestrierungsrollen.

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Titre de l'emploi: Directeur, Stratégie de développement durable et intégration

#LI-Hybrid

Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

Établir le lien entre la stratégie mondiale de durabilité environnementale et l'impact significatif au niveau des pays. En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l'intégration de la durabilité environnementale, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la traduction des ambitions des entreprises en stratégies nationales efficaces, conformément aux priorités mondiales de Novartis, aux développements externes et aux attentes des parties prenantes. Le rôle sera d'élaborer, de diriger et de mettre en oeuvre, de façon indépendante, des initiatives stratégiques clés pour les organisations commerciales nationales, et de participer à ces initiatives avec les partenaires du système de santé.

Ce rôle relève du responsable mondial de la stratégie d'impact social et de durabilité et travaille en étroite collaboration avec le directeur général de la durabilité, Affaires publiques, les dirigeants régionaux et nationaux, et le comité mondial ESG (l'organe de décision de Novartis pour l'impact social et la durabilité).

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Stratégie globale de Cascade Novartis sur l'impact social et la durabilité (SI&S) – mettant l'accent sur la durabilité environnementale – dans les unités commerciales et les organisations nationales, transformant les priorités des entreprises en orientations claires et pratiques et en feuilles de route de mise en œuvre pertinentes au niveau local.

• Mettre au point des solutions évolutives en matière de durabilité, en transformant les initiatives de validation de conception au niveau du pays en approches ayant un potentiel mondial plus vaste (p. ex. programmes de circonspection et initiatives de décarbonisation des voies de soins aux patients).

• Surveiller les attentes et les exigences émergentes du marché de l'environnement - y compris celles des organismes de réglementation, des payeurs, des organisations du secteur de la santé et de la santé, des partenaires du système de santé et des clients (par exemple, au moyen d'appels d'offres) - et traduire les développements en idées, en risques et en mesures recommandées.

• Partenaire avec les équipes d'accès au marché, HEOR, Policy et Commercial pour intégrer les considérations environnementales dans les propositions de valeur, les stratégies d'accès au marché et l'engagement du système de santé.

• Établir des partenariats et de nouvelles initiatives qui favorisent la décarbonisation des voies de soins, les soins de santé résilients au climat et la durabilité environnementale; établir des relations avec les intervenants du système de santé.

• Appuyer les politiques nationales et les activités de sensibilisation axées sur la durabilité environnementale, le climat et la santé.

• Coordonner les besoins en matière de divulgation aux niveaux régional et national, y compris les réponses aux appels d'offres et aux achats écologiques; appuyer les équipes mondiales des finances, des opérations et de la divulgation sur les demandes de données.

• Diriger et appuyer les axes de travail prioritaires de l'Initiative sur les marchés durables (IMS) et du Groupe de l'environnement pharmaceutique (GPE), notamment les efforts de circonspection, le Consortium d'évaluation du cycle de vie des médicaments (ACV) et les initiatives de décarbonisation des voies de soins aux patients, la coordination des équipes de pays internes et des partenaires externes pour obtenir des résultats tangibles.

• Appuyer la mise en œuvre au niveau des pays des stratégies de la portée 3 et des plans de transition connexes, en s'associant aux fonctions pertinentes pour traduire les priorités mondiales en initiatives pouvant donner lieu à des actions locales telles que les voyages d'affaires, la distribution locale et l'adoption de véhicules électriques.

• Guider les équipes commerciales nationales et mondiales sur les priorités de décarbonisation et de durabilité environnementale. Renforcer les capacités des pays grâce à des conseils pratiques, à des livres de lecture, à la formation et à des communautés de pratique.

Exigences essentielles

• Maîtrise en stratégie, ingénierie, développement durable ou sciences de la vie, ou expérience professionnelle pertinente équivalente.

• Fortes connaissances sur des sujets clés de durabilité environnementale, y compris : Étendue 3 des émissions, évaluation du cycle de vie et empreinte environnementale des produits, circularité.

• Réussir à mettre en oeuvre des initiatives stratégiques en matière de durabilité environnementale et à influer sur les programmes de durabilité des entreprises.

• Expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique avec une bonne compréhension de l'accès aux marchés, de l'économie de la santé, des marchés publics et des processus d'appel d'offres.

• Une vaste expérience à la tête de projets et de programmes stratégiques complexes impliquant des cadres supérieurs (y compris la direction, la direction) et des équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Capacité de traduire des sujets complexes de durabilité en idées claires et orientées vers la décision, en recommandations et en communications au niveau de la direction.

• Succès démontré dans la navigation d'organisations matricielles complexes et influence entre les fonctions sans autorité hiérarchique officielle.

• Capacité d'équilibrer l'intention stratégique et la réalité opérationnelle; expérience des rôles d'intégration, de transformation ou d'orchestration de programmes.

• Forte expérience du développement de partenariats et de collaborations multipartites avec les systèmes de santé, les décideurs, les associations industrielles, les clients et les partenaires externes.

De plus, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, si possible, et un congé parental rémunéré minimum de 14 semaines.

jobs.title: Global Head Global Clinical Supply (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF207,900.00 - CHF386,100.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
The Global Head Global Clinical Supply is accountable for global, end-to-end clinical supply performance, ensuring Novartis medicines reach patients on time, every time and enabling successful delivery of the development portfolio. The role sets GCS strategic direction and translates it into supply strategies, investment priorities and organizational capabilities that deliver reliable execution and sustainable value. As the strategic interface between clinical and technical teams, the role aligns enterprise decisions and partnerships to anticipate risk, navigate complexity and respond to evolving portfolio needs. The role leads a significant digital and organizational transformation, moving GCS from manual coordination towards integrated, data-driven and AI-enabled supply orchestration. It owns adoption and business outcomes—not technology implementation alone—while safeguarding quality, compliance and uninterrupted patient supply. As a member of the TRD Global Leadership Team, the role shapes TRD strategy and builds the leadership, capabilities and culture required to sustain performance through transformation.

Job Description
Patient supply accountability , strategy and enterprise partnerships

• Is ultimately accountable to ensure the availability of our medicines worldwide for all global and local clinical studies by driving an agile Clinical Supply Chain through streamlined and robust processes and systems;

• As a member of TRD Global Leadership Team, actively contribute to TRD strategy, vision and operations; represent TRD at cross-functional decision-/ governance boards (as appropriate).

• Establish and maintain strong business relations and interfaces to key partners and stakeholders outside TRD such as Development Operations / Clinical, BR;

Digital transformation , data, AI and change

• Seeks for opportunities & drives continuous performance improvement programs on the supply chain structure, organization, processes and supporting systems to ensure optimal positioning of GCS organization towards future trends;

• Leads the significant digital transformation of the end-to-end clinical supply chain, building on the LDC/SAP S4 and ICSM foundation. Embeds process simplification, standardization, clear ownership and operational discipline before scaling advanced analytics, intelligent automation and AI-enabled workflows. Prioritizes high-value use cases across planning, sourcing, packaging, labelling and distribution, and drives sustained adoption, integration into daily work and measurable business impact;

• Owns business accountability for the integrated GCS digital, systems and data landscape, in partnership with Digital CMC and enterprise technology teams. Establishes clear data ownership and stewardship, robust data quality and reusable data products to enable trusted analytics, predictive planning and scalable AI adoption;

Supply governance, execution, compliance and financial performance

• Ensures cross-functional demand and supply oversight and governance, Ensure optimal resource allocation and appropriate make vs. Leads cross-functional, end-to-end demand and supply oversight and decision governance through TRD-level Clinical Sales and Operations Planning (CS&OP), enabling consolidated visibility, scenario-based prioritization and timely decisions across demand, supply, packaging and distribution. Ensures optimal resource allocation and make-versus-buy decisions aligned with portfolio priorities, capacity, technology strategy, supply risk and sustainable value;

• Ensure embedding best practices on key processes such as global development project planning (incl. life-cycle management), warehouse & distribution logistics execution.
Ensures scalable capabilities for increasing portfolio and modality complexity, including radioligand therapies, and the timely integration of new assets and platforms through robust planning, compliant logistics and trade flows, and effective strategic vendor management.

• Ensures fully compliant processes and execution within our quality systems regulations such as but not limited to product quality and compliance, HSE, good logistics practices, security, finance and accounting;

• Ensure compliance and target achievement in areas of Cost, Quality (GMP & GCP) and Supply/ Delivery Performance;
Embeds a balanced performance framework covering patient supply reliability, right-first-time execution, end-to-end lead times, inventory efficiency, productivity and environmental sustainability. Drives waste and CO₂ reduction without compromising quality, compliance or continuity of patient supply

• Owns the prioritization and financial stewardship of the GCS transformation portfolio, aligning investment and resource allocation with business value. Establishes benefits tracking for productivity, capacity, lead times, inventory, waste and external spend, distinguishing planned benefits from realized outcomes;

Organization, talent and capability building

• Shapes and leads a scalable, future-ready global GCS operating model, aligning organizational structures, accountabilities, capabilities and capacity with portfolio needs and the digital transformation journey. Evolves roles from manual coordination towards strategic supply leadership, scenario evaluation, risk sensing and ecosystem orchestration, while sustaining reliable delivery throughout the transition;

• Provides development, training and coaching in order to maintain a talent pool that assures a high performance organization. Ensures the cross-fertilization of know-how within the organization to enhance the performance by sharing of best practice;
Builds a high-performing, human-centric and resilient GCS organization through leadership development, succession planning, coaching and targeted capability building. Strengthens clinical supply expertise, data and systems literacy, AI fluency, critical thinking, scenario planning and change leadership. Creates an environment of continuous learning, knowledge sharing and cross-functional collaboration, equipping associates to adopt new ways of working and exercise accountable judgment in AI-supported workflows

• Ensures the cross-fertilization of know-how within the organization and other Supply Chain Functions/Operations to enhance the performance by sharing of best practice;

Ideal Background

Education (minimum/desirable):

University degree (MBA, MS, PhD) in Science/Life Science (Pharmaceutical Technology, Engineering or related fields), Economics/Finance or General Management

Languages:

Fluent in English, second language- preferred

Experience/Professional requirement:

• 10+ years’ experience in a variety of managerial roles in a large international organization; e.g. significant experience in senior leadership positions in the pharmaceutical industry

• Excellent knowledge of Business Processes within the pharmaceutical industry, either operational or supply chain processes; i.e.Relevant experience in Pharmaceutical Development, Clinical Supply Operations, project management and related Fields or relevant experience in Supply Chain Management.

• Several years of experience managing people; must embrace people engagement as a key to high business performance

• Effective within a matrix environment with proven track record to successfully manage large cross-functional and interdisciplinary teams to embrace continuous improvement.

• Proven experience leading a significant, multi-year digital and organizational transformation in a regulated pharmaceutical or supply chain environment, translating strategy into integrated roadmaps, operating model evolution, sustained adoption and measurable business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of integrated ERP and clinical supply planning ecosystems, such as SAP S4/LDC and ICSM, together with data governance, advanced analytics, automation and AI-enabled planning. Ability to act as an accountable business owner and partner effectively with technology, data and digital teams.

• Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end supply governance, scenario-based planning, supply risk management, inventory optimization and strategic external partner management across a complex global portfolio.

• Proven ability to build future-ready capabilities and lead teams through substantial change, combining clinical supply expertise with digital fluency, critical thinking, continuous learning and accountable decision-making.

• Sound understanding of responsible AI and digital governance in a GxP environment, including data integrity, validation, traceability, human oversight and business continuity.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: € 207,900 to € 386,100

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata:
CHF207,900.00 - CHF386,100.00

Descrizione del lavoro
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera #onsite

Scopo del ruolo:
Il Global Head Global Clinical Supply è responsabile per le prestazioni di approvvigionamento clinico globale, end-to-end, assicurando che i farmaci Novartis raggiungano i pazienti in tempo, ogni volta e consentendo una consegna riuscita del portafoglio di sviluppo. Il ruolo definisce la direzione strategica del GCS e la traduce in strategie di approvvigionamento, priorità di investimento e capacità organizzative che offrono esecuzione affidabile e valore sostenibile. Come interfaccia strategica tra team clinici e tecnici, il ruolo allinea le decisioni aziendali e le partnership per anticipare il rischio, navigare nella complessità e rispondere alle esigenze di portafoglio in evoluzione. Il ruolo conduce una significativa trasformazione digitale e organizzativa, spostando il GCS dal coordinamento manuale verso l'orchestrazione integrata, basata sui dati e abilitata all'IA. Possiede l'adozione e i risultati aziendali, non solo l'implementazione della tecnologia, mentre salvaguarda la qualità, la conformità e la fornitura ininterrotta del paziente. Come membro del TRD Global Leadership Team, il ruolo forma la strategia TRD e costruisce la leadership, le capacità e la cultura necessarie per sostenere le prestazioni attraverso la trasformazione.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità dell'approvvigionamento dei pazienti, partnership di strategia e impresa

• È in ultima analisi responsabile garantire la disponibilità dei nostri farmaci in tutto il mondo per tutti gli studi clinici globali e locali, guidando una catena di fornitura clinica agile attraverso processi e sistemi semplificati e robusti;

• In qualità di membro del TRD Global Leadership Team, contribuire attivamente alla strategia, alla visione e alle operazioni di TRD; rappresentare TRD nei comitati decisionali e di governance interfunzionali (come opportuno).

• Stabilire e mantenere forti relazioni commerciali e interfacce per partner chiave e stakeholder al di fuori di TRD come operazioni di sviluppo / Clinical, BR;

Trasformazione digitale, dati, AI e cambiamento

• Cerca opportunità e guida programmi di miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni sulla struttura della supply chain, organizzazione, processi e sistemi di supporto per garantire un posizionamento ottimale dell'organizzazione GCS verso le tendenze future;

• Conduce la significativa trasformazione digitale della catena di fornitura clinica end-to-end, che si basa sulla fondazione LDC/SAP S4 e ICSM. Embeds processo semplificazione, standardizzazione, chiara proprietà e disciplina operativa prima di scalare i flussi di lavoro avanzati di analisi, automazione intelligente e AI. Priorizza casi di utilizzo ad alto valore attraverso la pianificazione, l'approvvigionamento, l'imballaggio, l'etichettatura e la distribuzione, e guida l'adozione sostenuta, l'integrazione nel lavoro quotidiano e l'impatto commerciale misurabile;

• Possiede la responsabilità aziendale per il digitale, i sistemi e il paesaggio dei dati integrati GCS, in collaborazione con i team di tecnologia Digital CMC e enterprise. Stabilisce una chiara proprietà e una gestione dei dati, una solida qualità dei dati e prodotti di dati riutilizzabili per consentire analisi attendibili, pianificazione predittiva e adozione scalabile dell'AI;

Governance, esecuzione, conformità e performance finanziarie

• Garantisce la domanda interfunzionale e la supervisione e la governance dell'offerta, assicura l'allocazione ottimale delle risorse e l'appropriata presa vs. Leads cross-functional, end-to-end domanda e oversight dell'offerta e governance delle decisioni attraverso TRD-level Clinical Sales and Operations Planning (CS&OP), consentendo visibilità consolidata, priorità basata sugli scenari e decisioni tempestive su domanda, offerta, imballaggio e distribuzione. Garantisce l'allocazione ottimale delle risorse e le decisioni di make-versus-buy allineate con priorità del portafoglio, capacità, strategia tecnologica, rischio di approvvigionamento e valore sostenibile;

• Assicurarsi di integrare le migliori pratiche nei processi chiave come la pianificazione globale del progetto di sviluppo (inclusa la gestione del ciclo di vita), l'esecuzione della logistica della distribuzione e del magazzino.
Garantisce capacità scalabili per aumentare la complessità del portafoglio e della modalità, tra cui le terapie radioligand, e l'integrazione tempestiva di nuovi asset e piattaforme attraverso una pianificazione robusta, una logistica conforme e flussi commerciali, e un'efficace gestione strategica dei fornitori.

• Garantisce processi ed esecuzione pienamente conformi ai nostri sistemi di qualità, come ma non limitati alla qualità del prodotto e alla conformità, HSE, buone pratiche logistiche, sicurezza, finanza e contabilità;

• Assicurare la conformità e il raggiungimento dell'obiettivo in aree di costi, qualità (GMP & GCP) e prestazioni di fornitura / consegna;
Integra un quadro di prestazioni equilibrato che copre l'affidabilità dell'offerta dei pazienti, l'esecuzione di destra, i tempi di guida end-to-end, l'efficienza dell'inventario, la produttività e la sostenibilità ambientale. Guida la riduzione dei rifiuti e della CO2 senza compromettere la qualità, la conformità o la continuità dell'offerta dei pazienti

• Possiede la priorità e la gestione finanziaria del portafoglio di trasformazione GCS, allineando gli investimenti e l'allocazione delle risorse con il valore aziendale. Stabilisce il monitoraggio dei benefici per produttività, capacità, tempi di piombo, inventario, rifiuti e spesa esterna, distinguendo i benefici previsti dai risultati realizzati;

Organizzazione, talento e capacità di costruzione

• Forma e guida un modello operativo GCS globale scalabile e pronto per il futuro, allineando strutture organizzative, responsabilità, capacità e capacità con le esigenze del portafoglio e il percorso di trasformazione digitale. Svolge ruoli di coordinamento manuale verso la leadership strategica di approvvigionamento, la valutazione degli scenari, il rilevamento dei rischi e l'orchestrazione dell'ecosistema, mentre sostiene la consegna affidabile durante la transizione;

• Fornisce sviluppo, formazione e coaching per mantenere un pool di talenti che assicura un'organizzazione ad alte prestazioni. Assicura la cross-fertilizzazione del know-how all'interno dell'organizzazione per migliorare le prestazioni condividendo le migliori pratiche;
Costruisce un'organizzazione GCS altamente performante, umana-centrica e resiliente attraverso lo sviluppo di leadership, la pianificazione di successione, l'addestramento e la costruzione di capacità mirate. Rafforza le competenze di approvvigionamento clinico, l'alfabetizzazione dei dati e dei sistemi, la fluidità dell'intelligenza artificiale, il pensiero critico, la pianificazione degli scenari e la leadership di cambiamento. Crea un ambiente di apprendimento continuo, condivisione delle conoscenze e collaborazione interfunzionale, dotando i soci per adottare nuovi modi di lavorare ed esercitare un giudizio responsabile nei flussi di lavoro supportati dall'IA

• Garantisce la cross-fertilizzazione del know-how all'interno dell'organizzazione e di altre funzioni/Operazioni Supply Chain per migliorare le prestazioni condividendo le migliori pratiche;

Sfondo ideale

Istruzione (minimo/desiderabile):

Laurea universitaria (MBA, MS, PhD) in Scienza/Scienza della vita (Tecnologia farmaceutica, Ingegneria o campi correlati), Economia/Finanza o Gestione generale

Lingue:

Fluente in inglese, seconda lingua- preferita

Esperienza / requisito professionale:

• 10+ anni di esperienza in una varietà di ruoli manageriali in una grande organizzazione internazionale; ad esempio esperienza significativa in posizioni di leadership senior nell'industria farmaceutica

• Ottima conoscenza dei processi aziendali all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica, dei processi operativi o della supply chain; cioè esperienza rilevante nello sviluppo farmaceutico, nelle operazioni di approvvigionamento clinico, nella gestione dei progetti e nei campi correlati o nell'esperienza rilevante nella gestione della supply chain.

• Diversi anni di esperienza gestendo le persone; deve abbracciare il coinvolgimento delle persone come una chiave per alte prestazioni aziendali

• Efficace all'interno di un ambiente matrice con un record di traccia collaudato per gestire con successo grandi team interfunzionali e interdisciplinari per abbracciare il miglioramento continuo.

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce una significativa e pluriennale trasformazione digitale e organizzativa in un ambiente regolamentato farmaceutico o catena di fornitura, traducendo strategia in roadmap integrate, evoluzione del modello operativo, adozione sostenuta e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Forte comprensione degli ecosistemi integrati di pianificazione dell'offerta e dell'offerta clinica, come SAP S4/LDC e ICSM, insieme alla governance dei dati, analisi avanzate, automazione e pianificazione basata sull'intelligenza artificiale. Capacità di agire come proprietario di business responsabile e collaborare efficacemente con la tecnologia, i dati e i team digitali.

• Competenza dimostrata nella governance della fornitura end-to-end, pianificazione basata su scenari, gestione del rischio di fornitura, ottimizzazione dell'inventario e gestione strategica dei partner esterni in un portafoglio globale complesso.

• Capacità comprovata di costruire capacità pronte e guidare i team attraverso un cambiamento sostanziale, combinando competenze di approvvigionamento clinico con fluidità digitale, pensiero critico, apprendimento continuo e processo decisionale responsabile.

• Comprensione sonora di AI responsabile e governance digitale in un ambiente GxP, tra cui integrità dei dati, validazione, tracciabilità, supervisione umana e continuità aziendale.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Gamma di insalata annuale prevista per il ruolo: € 207,900 a € 386,100

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Stärkt klinische Versorgungskompetenz, Daten- und Systemkompetenz, KI-Fließfähigkeit, kritisches Denken, Szenarioplanung und Change Leadership. Universitätsabschluss (MBA, MS, PhD) in Science / Life Science (Pharmaceutical Technology, Engineering oder verwandte Bereiche), Wirtschaft / Finanzen oder General Management

fließend Englisch, Zweitsprache - bevorzugt

Erfahrung/berufliche Anforderung:

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Lieu: Bâle, Suisse #onsite

Rôle But :
Le Global Head Global Clinical Approvisionnement est responsable de la performance de l'approvisionnement clinique de bout en bout, garantissant que les médicaments Novartis atteignent les patients à temps, à chaque fois et permettant une livraison réussie du portefeuille de développement. Ce rôle définit l'orientation stratégique du SGC et le traduit en stratégies d'approvisionnement, en priorités d'investissement et en capacités organisationnelles qui assurent une exécution fiable et une valeur durable. En tant qu'interface stratégique entre les équipes cliniques et techniques, le rôle aligne les décisions d'entreprise et les partenariats pour anticiper les risques, naviguer dans la complexité et répondre aux besoins changeants du portefeuille. Ce rôle mène à une transformation numérique et organisationnelle importante, faisant passer le SGC de la coordination manuelle à l'orchestration intégrée, axée sur les données et adaptée à l'IA. Elle est propriétaire de l'adoption et des résultats commerciaux, et non pas seulement de la mise en oeuvre de la technologie, tout en préservant la qualité, la conformité et l'approvisionnement continu des patients. En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership mondial de la DRT, ce rôle façonne la stratégie de la DRT et renforce le leadership, les capacités et la culture nécessaires pour soutenir le rendement par la transformation.

Description de l'emploi
Responsabilité de l'approvisionnement des patients , stratégie et partenariats d'entreprise

• est en fin de compte responsable d'assurer la disponibilité de nos médicaments dans le monde entier pour toutes les études cliniques mondiales et locales en conduisant une chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique agile grâce à des processus et systèmes rationalisés et robustes;

• En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership mondial de la DRT, contribuer activement à la stratégie, à la vision et aux opérations de la DRT; représenter la DRT aux conseils de décision et de gouvernance interfonctionnels (selon le cas).

• Établir et maintenir de solides relations d'affaires et des interfaces avec les principaux partenaires et intervenants extérieurs à la DRT, tels que les opérations de développement / clinique, BR;

Transformation numérique, données, AI et changement

• recherche des possibilités et encourage des programmes d'amélioration continue du rendement sur la structure de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, l'organisation, les processus et les systèmes de soutien pour assurer un positionnement optimal de l'organisation du SGC vers les tendances futures;

• Dirige la transformation numérique importante de la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique de bout en bout, en s'appuyant sur la fondation S4 et ICSM des PMA/PAS. Intégrer la simplification des processus, la normalisation, la prise en charge claire et la discipline opérationnelle avant d'étendre l'analyse avancée, l'automatisation intelligente et les flux de travail liés à l'IA. Privilégier les cas d'utilisation de grande valeur dans la planification, l'approvisionnement, l'emballage, l'étiquetage et la distribution, et favoriser l'adoption durable, l'intégration dans le travail quotidien et l'impact opérationnel mesurable;

• Possède la responsabilité opérationnelle du paysage numérique, des systèmes et des données intégré du SGC, en partenariat avec le CMC numérique et les équipes technologiques d'entreprise. Établir une appropriation et une intendance claires des données, une qualité robuste des données et des produits de données réutilisables pour permettre une analyse fiable, une planification prédictive et une adoption évolutive de l'IA;

Gouvernance, exécution, conformité et résultats financiers

• Assurer la surveillance et la gouvernance interfonctionnelles de la demande et de l'offre, assurer une allocation optimale des ressources et une prise de décisions appropriée par rapport aux responsables, assurer la surveillance et la gouvernance de la demande et de l'offre de bout en bout et de l'offre par le biais de la planification des ventes et des opérations cliniques au niveau du TRD, ce qui permet une visibilité consolidée, une hiérarchisation fondée sur des scénarios et des décisions en temps opportun concernant la demande, l'offre, l'emballage et la distribution. Assurer une allocation optimale des ressources et des décisions d'achat par rapport aux priorités du portefeuille, aux capacités, à la stratégie technologique, au risque d'offre et à la valeur durable;

• Veiller à intégrer les pratiques exemplaires à des processus clés tels que la planification de projets de développement mondial (y compris la gestion du cycle de vie), l'exécution logistique des entrepôts et de la distribution.
Assure des capacités évolutives pour accroître la complexité du portefeuille et des modalités, y compris les thérapies radioligandiques, et l'intégration en temps opportun de nouveaux actifs et plates-formes grâce à une planification robuste, à des flux logistiques et commerciaux conformes et à une gestion stratégique efficace des fournisseurs.

• S'assure que les processus et l'exécution sont entièrement conformes à nos règlements sur les systèmes de qualité, notamment la qualité et la conformité des produits, le HSE, les bonnes pratiques logistiques, la sécurité, les finances et la comptabilité;

• Assurer la conformité et l'atteinte des objectifs dans les domaines des coûts, de la qualité (BPF et BPF) et du rendement en matière d'approvisionnement et de prestation;
Intégre un cadre de performance équilibré couvrant la fiabilité de l'approvisionnement des patients, l'exécution de la première fois, les délais d'exécution de bout en bout, l'efficacité des stocks, la productivité et la durabilité environnementale. Conduit la réduction des déchets et du CO2 sans compromettre la qualité, la conformité ou la continuité de l'approvisionnement du patient

• Détenir la priorité et la gérance financière du portefeuille de transformation du SGC, en alignant l'investissement et l'affectation des ressources avec la valeur opérationnelle. Établir le suivi des avantages pour la productivité, la capacité, les délais, les stocks, les déchets et les dépenses externes, en distinguant les avantages prévus des résultats obtenus;

Organisation, compétences et renforcement des capacités

• Forme et dirige un modèle opérationnel mondial évolutif et prêt à l'avenir, en harmonisant les structures organisationnelles, les responsabilités, les capacités et les capacités avec les besoins du portefeuille et le parcours de transformation numérique. Évoque les rôles allant de la coordination manuelle à la direction stratégique de l'approvisionnement, à l'évaluation des scénarios, à la détection des risques et à l'orchestration des écosystèmes, tout en maintenant une prestation fiable tout au long de la transition;

• Fournit du perfectionnement, de la formation et du coaching afin de maintenir un bassin de talents qui assure une organisation à haut rendement. Assurer la fécondation croisée du savoir-faire au sein de l'organisation pour améliorer la performance en partageant les meilleures pratiques;
Bâtir une organisation de SGC hautement performante, axée sur l'humain et résiliente grâce au perfectionnement en leadership, à la planification de la relève, à l'encadrement et au renforcement des capacités ciblées. Renforcer l'expertise clinique en matière d'approvisionnement, la littératie des données et des systèmes, la maîtrise de l'IA, la pensée critique, la planification des scénarios et le leadership du changement. Créer un environnement d'apprentissage continu, de partage des connaissances et de collaboration interfonctionnelle, équiper les associés pour adopter de nouvelles façons de travailler et exercer un jugement responsable dans les flux de travail soutenus par l'IA

• Assurer la fécondation croisée du savoir-faire au sein de l'organisation et d'autres fonctions/opérations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement afin d'améliorer la performance en partageant les meilleures pratiques;

Contexte idéal

Éducation (minimum/désirable):

Diplôme universitaire (MBA, MS, doctorat) en sciences/sciences de la vie (technologie pharmaceutique, génie ou domaines connexes), économie/finance ou gestion générale

Langues:

Fluent en anglais, langue seconde - préféré

Expérience/exigence professionnelle :

• 10 ans et plus Expérience dans divers rôles de gestion au sein d'une grande organisation internationale; par exemple, expérience importante dans les postes de direction dans l'industrie pharmaceutique

• Excellente connaissance des processus opérationnels au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, soit des processus opérationnels ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement; c.-à-d. une expérience pertinente en développement pharmaceutique, en opérations cliniques d'approvisionnement, en gestion de projet et dans des domaines connexes ou une expérience pertinente en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la gestion des personnes; doit intégrer l'engagement des personnes comme clé d'une performance opérationnelle élevée

• Efficace dans un environnement matriciel avec des antécédents éprouvés pour gérer avec succès de grandes équipes interfonctionnelles et interdisciplinaires pour accepter l'amélioration continue.

• Expérience éprouvée menant une transformation numérique et organisationnelle importante et pluriannuelle dans un environnement pharmaceutique ou de chaîne d'approvisionnement réglementé, transformant la stratégie en feuilles de route intégrées, évolution du modèle opérationnel, adoption soutenue et résultats opérationnels mesurables.

• Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes intégrés de planification des ERP et des approvisionnements cliniques, tels que SAP S4/LDC et ICSM, ainsi que de la gouvernance des données, de l'analyse avancée, de l'automatisation et de la planification adaptée à l'IA. Capacité d'agir en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise responsable et partenaire efficace avec des équipes technologiques, de données et numériques.

• Expertise démontrée en matière de gouvernance de l'offre de bout en bout, de planification fondée sur des scénarios, de gestion des risques de l'offre, d'optimisation des stocks et de gestion stratégique de partenaires externes dans un portefeuille mondial complexe.

• Capacité éprouvée de créer des capacités prêtes à l'avenir et de diriger des équipes grâce à des changements substantiels, en combinant l'expertise clinique en matière d'approvisionnement avec l'aisance numérique, la pensée critique, l'apprentissage continu et la prise de décisions responsables.

• Une bonne compréhension de l'IA responsable et de la gouvernance numérique dans un environnement GxP, y compris l'intégrité des données, la validation, la traçabilité, la surveillance humaine et la continuité des activités.

Avantages et récompenses

À Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui y arrivent.

Barème des traitements de base annuels prévus pour le rôle : 207 900 à 386 100 euros

Le salaire de base offert est déterminé en fonction d'objectifs non sexistes, tels que les compétences, les compétences et l'expérience pertinentes conformément à la politique d'établissement de la rémunération de Novartis et lors de son adhésion à Novartis sera examiné périodiquement.

En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime basée sur le rendement selon certains paramètres de rendement.

Les récompenses de faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà de la rémunération de base et des incitatifs. Nous offrons également une variété d'avantages concurrentiels en nature pour vous aider à prospérer personnellement et professionnellement, comme les régimes d'assurance, les régimes de retraite, les ressources de bien-être et les programmes de reconnaissance mondiale. De plus, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, si possible, et un congé parental rémunéré minimum de 14 semaines.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit der Anwendung von KI wie maschinellem Lernen, generativer KI oder agentischen Systemen zur Automatisierung oder Verbesserung von Workflows mit einem Verständnis ihrer Grenzen und der Bewertung von Ergebnissen.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: TA Head, PKS Immunology
Location: Basel

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary scientific leader to join us as TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In this highly visible role, you will lead a cross-functional scientific organization spanning pharmacokinetics, clinical pharmacology, bioanalysis, and quantitative pharmacology across discovery, early development, and late-stage development. You will play a critical role in advancing the immunology portfolio, shaping integrated development strategies and enabling high-quality portfolio decisions.

As TA Head, PKS Immunology, you will provide strategic and scientific leadership across a portfolio of diverse modalities with a broad translational sciences remit. You will be responsible for defining fit-for-purpose development strategies across programs, ensuring scientific rigor in execution, and building strong partnerships across research, development, regulatory, and portfolio teams. This role requires a leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. You will also lead and develop scientists and serve as an important internal and external representative of the organization.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement integrated platform and program strategies from discovery through registration

• Support data-driven decision-making and differentiated development strategies for the immunology portfolio

• Oversee pharmacokinetic, clinical pharmacology, bioanalytical and quantitative pharmacology contributions to regulatory submissions and supporting documentation

• Support health authority interactions by ensuring high-quality scientific input into development and regulatory strategies

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across discovery, development, regulatory, and other key partner functions to ensure rigorous and efficient program execution

• Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing scientific team, including oversight of PKS Immunology scientists

• Serve as a scientific thought leader internally and externally through collaborations, publications, presentations, and participation in relevant scientific forums

• Promote operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources

• Leverage digital tools, AI, and automation, where appropriate, to enhance insight generation, efficiency, and decision-making

Leadership Behaviors in Action

• Deliver results through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on value and outcomes

• Demonstrate an enterprise mindset and strong ownership by prioritizing resources and decisions for maximum portfolio and patient impact

• Role‑model leadership behaviors through visible actions, continuous self‑reflection, and openness to feedback

• Build trust through transparent communication, clear accountability, and consistent delivery against commitments

• Empower others to innovate and improve while maintaining high scientific, ethical, and operational standards

AI Fluency

• Bring strong AI and digital fluency, using enterprise tools to enhance insight generation, decision‑making, and team productivity

• Accountable for the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI in line with enterprise AI governance and data protection standards

External Eminence

• Act as an external thought leader, advancing and elevating Novartis’ reputation in translational science and innovation

Operational Excellence

• Drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources to maximize PKS and enterprise value

• Act as a responsible steward of people, data, and digital capabilities, leveraging AI and automation to improve efficiency, quality, and decision speed

• Apply value‑based prioritization and resource awareness to ensure efforts are focused on the highest‑impact scientific and portfolio outcomes

Essential Requirements

• PhD or PharmD in pharmacokinetics, pharmacology, pharmaceutics, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline

• Significant biopharmaceutical industry experience, typically 12 or more years, spanning preclinical and clinical drug research and development, including senior leadership responsibility

• Demonstrated people leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, coaching, and developing scientific talent

• Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements and experience contributing to submissions such as INDs, IMPDs, NDAs, and BLAs

• Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional environment and influence across teams and organizational levels

• Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of scientific rigor and sound judgment

Desirable Requirements

• Experience in immunological disease

• Experience in bioanalytical assay development and immunogenicity assessments

• Demonstrated experience across different modalities, including small molecules, mAbs, and potentially CAR-T cell therapies

• Familiarity with late-stage development and registration-enabling activities

• Experience applying digital tools, AI, or machine learning to scientific decision-making and development execution

• Track record of external scientific visibility through publications, presentations, or industry/academic engagement

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• 169,400.00 - 314,600.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a
position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Titolo interno: TA Head, PKS Immunology
Ubicazione: Basilea

Stiamo cercando un leader scientifico esperto e visionario per unirsi a noi come TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In questo ruolo altamente visibile, si porterà un'organizzazione scientifica interfunzionale che comprende la farmacocinetica, la farmacologia clinica, la bioanalisi e la farmacologia quantitativa attraverso la scoperta, lo sviluppo precoce e lo sviluppo del tardo stadio. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere il portafoglio di immunologia, modellare strategie di sviluppo integrate e consentire decisioni di portafoglio di alta qualità.

Come TA Head, PKS Immunology, fornirete leadership strategica e scientifica in un portafoglio di diverse modalità con un ampio remit di scienze traduttive. Sarete responsabili della definizione di strategie di sviluppo fit-for-purpose attraverso i programmi, garantendo rigore scientifico nell'esecuzione, e la costruzione di partnership forti tra i team di ricerca, sviluppo, regolazione e portafoglio. Questo ruolo richiede un leader che combina competenze tecniche profonde con una forte leadership organizzativa, giudizio sonoro, e la capacità di influenzare attraverso un'organizzazione matrice. Potrai anche condurre e sviluppare scienziati e servire come un importante rappresentante interno ed esterno dell'organizzazione.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Definire e implementare strategie integrate di piattaforma e programma dalla scoperta attraverso la registrazione

• Supporta le strategie di sviluppo differenziate e decisionali basate sui dati per il portafoglio di immunologia

• Superare i contributi farmacocinetici, farmacologici clinici, bioanalitici e quantitativi di farmacologia alle sottomissioni normative e alla documentazione di supporto

• Supporta le interazioni dell'autorità sanitaria garantendo un input scientifico di alta qualità nelle strategie di sviluppo e di regolamentazione

• Guidare la collaborazione interfunzionale attraverso la scoperta, lo sviluppo, la regolamentazione e altre funzioni partner chiave per garantire l'esecuzione rigorosa ed efficiente del programma

• Costruire, guidare, mentore e sviluppare un team scientifico altamente performante, tra cui la supervisione di scienziati PKS Immunology

• Servire come leader di pensiero scientifico internamente ed esternamente attraverso collaborazioni, pubblicazioni, presentazioni e partecipazione a forum scientifici rilevanti

• Promuovere l'eccellenza operativa attraverso l'esecuzione disciplinata, il miglioramento continuo e l'utilizzo efficace delle risorse

• Levare strumenti digitali, AI e automazione, se del caso, per migliorare la generazione di insight, l'efficienza e il processo decisionale

Comportamenti di leadership in azione

• Fornire risultati attraverso l'esecuzione disciplinata, il miglioramento continuo, e una forte attenzione al valore e risultati

• Dimostrare una mentalità aziendale e una forte proprietà privilegiando risorse e decisioni per il massimo portafoglio e impatto paziente

• Comportamenti di leadership Role-model attraverso azioni visibili, autoriflessione continua e apertura al feedback

• Costruire la fiducia attraverso una comunicazione trasparente, una chiara responsabilità e una consegna coerente contro gli impegni

• Impedire agli altri di innovare e migliorare mantenendo elevati standard scientifici, etici e operativi

Flusso di AI

• Portare una forte intelligenza artificiale e una fluidità digitale, utilizzando strumenti aziendali per migliorare la generazione di insight, il processo decisionale e la produttività del team

• Contabile per l'uso etico, trasparente e conforme dell'IA in linea con gli standard di corporate AI governance e protezione dei dati

Eminenza esterna

• Agire come leader di pensiero esterno, avanzare e aumentare la reputazione di Novartis nella scienza traduttiva e innovazione

Eccellenza operativa

• Guidare l'eccellenza operativa attraverso l'esecuzione disciplinata, il miglioramento continuo e l'uso efficace delle risorse per massimizzare PKS e il valore aziendale

• Agire come amministratore responsabile delle persone, dei dati e delle capacità digitali, sfruttando l'IA e l'automazione per migliorare l'efficienza, la qualità e la velocità delle decisioni

• Applicare la priorità basata sul valore e la consapevolezza delle risorse per garantire che gli sforzi siano focalizzati sui risultati scientifici e di portafoglio più elevati

Requisiti essenziali

• PhD o PharmD in farmacocinetica, farmacologia, farmacia, biochimica o disciplina scientifica correlata

• Esperienza di settore biofarmaceutico significativa, tipicamente 12 o più anni, che abbraccia la ricerca e lo sviluppo di farmaci preclinici e clinici, compresa la responsabilità di leadership senior

• Esperienza di leadership dimostrata dalle persone, tra cui l'assunzione, il mentoring, l'addestramento e lo sviluppo di talento scientifico

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti normativi globali e dell'esperienza che contribuiscono a presentazioni come IND, IMPD, NDA e BLA

• Capacità comprovata di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente matrixed, cross-funzionale e influenza su team e livelli organizzativi

• Ottima comunicazione, pensiero strategico e capacità di problem solving, con un alto grado di rigore scientifico e giudizio sonoro

Requisiti desiderabili

• Esperienza nella malattia immunologica

• Esperienza nello sviluppo del test bioanalitico e nelle valutazioni dell'immunogenicità

• Esperienza dimostrata attraverso diverse modalità, tra cui piccole molecole, mAbs e terapie cellulari potenzialmente CAR-T

• Familiarità con le attività di sviluppo e registrazione tardive

• Esperienza di applicazione di strumenti digitali, AI, o machine learning per il processo decisionale scientifico e l'esecuzione di sviluppo

• Tracciare il record di visibilità scientifica esterna attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni o impegno industriale/accademico

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo:

• 169,400.00 - 314,600.00 CHF Annuale

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione.

Pay equity è un principio fondamentale della nostra politica di occupazione e riflette il nostro impegno a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo che tratta tutti i dipendenti con dignità e rispetto, come descritto nel nostro Codice Etico.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo sulla base della vostra posizione di lavoro e dell'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente all'utente durante il processo di applicazione.

Impegno alla diversità e all'inclusione / EEO
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale, inclusivo e rappresentativo di diverse squadre dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Accessibilità e alloggio
Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, è necessario un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di un
posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a Diversi.inclusion ch@novartis.com e farci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Diese Rolle erfordert eine Führungskraft, die tiefes technisches Fachwissen mit starker organisatorischer Führung, fundiertem Urteilsvermögen und der Fähigkeit, Einfluss auf eine matrixförmige Organisation zu nehmen, kombiniert. Sie werden auch Wissenschaftler leiten und entwickeln und als wichtiger interner und externer Vertreter der Organisation dienen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Definieren und implementieren Sie integrierte Plattform- und Programmstrategien von der Entdeckung bis zur Registrierung

• Unterstützung datengesteuerter Entscheidungsfindung und differenzierter Entwicklungsstrategien für das Immunologieportfolio

• Beaufsichtigen Sie pharmakokinetische, klinische Pharmakologie, bioanalytische und quantitative Pharmakologiebeiträge zu regulatorischen Einreichungen und unterstützende Dokumentation

• Unterstützen Sie die Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörden, indem Sie einen qualitativ hochwertigen wissenschaftlichen Beitrag zu Entwicklungs- und Regulierungsstrategien sicherstellen

• Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit über Discovery-, Entwicklungs-, Regulierungs- und andere wichtige Partnerfunktionen hinweg, um eine strenge und effiziente Programmausführung zu gewährleisten

• Aufbau, Leitung, Mentor und Entwicklung eines leistungsstarken wissenschaftlichen Teams, einschließlich der Aufsicht über PKS Immunology-Wissenschaftler

• Als wissenschaftlicher Vordenker intern und extern durch Kooperationen, Publikationen, Präsentationen und Teilnahme an relevanten wissenschaftlichen Foren dienen

• Förderung operativer Exzellenz durch disziplinierte Ausführung, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und effektive Nutzung von Ressourcen

• Nutzen Sie gegebenenfalls digitale Tools, KI und Automatisierung, um die Generierung, Effizienz und Entscheidungsfindung zu verbessern

Führungsverhalten in Aktion

• Ergebnisse durch disziplinierte Ausführung, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und einen starken Fokus auf Wert und Ergebnisse liefern

• Demonstrieren Sie eine Unternehmensmentalität und eine starke Eigenverantwortung, indem Sie Ressourcen und Entscheidungen für maximale Portfolio- und Patientenwirkung priorisieren

• Vorbildliches Führungsverhalten durch sichtbares Handeln, kontinuierliche Selbstreflexion und Offenheit für Feedback

• Aufbau von Vertrauen durch transparente Kommunikation, klare Rechenschaftspflicht und konsistente Erfüllung von Verpflichtungen

• Befähigen Sie andere, innovativ zu sein und sich zu verbessern, während Sie hohe wissenschaftliche, ethische und betriebliche Standards einhalten

AI Fluktuation

• Bringen Sie starke KI und digitale Flüssigkeit, mit Enterprise-Tools, um Insight-Generierung, Entscheidungsfindung und Teamproduktivität zu verbessern

• Verantwortlich für den ethischen, transparenten und konformen Einsatz von KI im Einklang mit Unternehmens-KI-Governance und Datenschutzstandards

Externe Eminenz

• Handeln Sie als externer Vordenker und fördern Sie den Ruf von Novartis in translationaler Wissenschaft und Innovation

Operative Exzellenz

• Steigern Sie operative Exzellenz durch disziplinierte Ausführung, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und effektive Nutzung von Ressourcen zur Maximierung von PKS und Unternehmenswert

• Handeln Sie als verantwortungsbewusster Verwalter von Menschen, Daten und digitalen Fähigkeiten und nutzen Sie KI und Automatisierung, um Effizienz, Qualität und Entscheidungsgeschwindigkeit zu verbessern

• Nutzenbasierte Priorisierung und Ressourcenbewusstsein anwenden, um sicherzustellen, dass sich die Bemühungen auf die wichtigsten wissenschaftlichen Ergebnisse und Portfolioergebnisse konzentrieren

Grundlegende Anforderungen

• PhD oder PharmD in Pharmakokinetik, Pharmakologie, Pharmazie, Biochemie oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin

• Bedeutende biopharmazeutische Industrieerfahrung, typischerweise 12 oder mehr Jahre, überspannend präklinische und klinische Arzneimittelforschung und -entwicklung, einschließlich Führungsverantwortung

• Demonstrierte Führungserfahrung von Menschen, einschließlich Einstellung, Mentoring, Coaching und Entwicklung wissenschaftlicher Talente

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen und Erfahrungen, die zu Einreichungen wie INDs, IMPDs, NDAs und BLAs beitragen

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer matrixförmigen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung zu arbeiten und Einfluss auf Teams und Organisationsebenen zu nehmen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, strategisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einem hohen Maß an wissenschaftlicher Strenge und fundiertem Urteilsvermögen

Erwünschte Anforderungen

• Erfahrung mit immunologischen Erkrankungen

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung bioanalytischer Assays und Immunogenitätsbewertungen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen über verschiedene Modalitäten hinweg, einschließlich kleiner Moleküle, mAbs und möglicherweise CAR-T-Zelltherapien

• Vertrautheit mit späten Entwicklungs- und Registrierungsaktivitäten

• Erfahrung in der Anwendung von digitalen Tools, KI oder maschinellem Lernen bei der wissenschaftlichen Entscheidungsfindung und Entwicklungsdurchführung

• Track Record der externen wissenschaftlichen Sichtbarkeit durch Publikationen, Präsentationen oder Industrie / akademischen Engagement
